breadcrumbs.name: RFID Anti-metal Tags — Reliable UHF Tracking On Steel, Aluminum & Metal Assets

summary: Standard UHF RFID tags fail on metal surfaces because the metal reflects and detunes the antenna. Anti-metal RFID tags solve this with a specialized construction that isolates the antenna from the metal substrate, enabling reliable UHF reads on machinery, vehicles, containers, tools and metal assets.
